verdict.rationale: incident.io documents an official remote MCP server for connecting AI assistants. It can 'query incidents, analyze alerts, check who's on call, manage escalations', and there is a public REST API at api.incident.io with a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0 spec. Escalation management via MCP is explicitly documented, but no evidence shows an agent can acknowledge a page or resolve or close an incident through the API or MCP. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at the common URL paths tried, though the docs say one can be downloaded. Missing for 10: documented acknowledge endpoint or MCP tool, documented resolve/close incident write operation, end-to-end agent workflow example, independent or hands-on corroboration.
